levels.name: Mia, 22, Intern
levels.story: Drei Profilaufrufe um 3 Uhr nachts auf der Stirn – und mein Ex lacht im Gruppenchat darüber. The 8 levels of ex-stalking intensity. Level 1. I am Mia, a stressed-out blueberry person with a cracked screen and zero self-control, drowning in a toxic mix of self-loathing and relentless obsession. I just wanted to see if my ex was online after our messy breakup last Tuesday, hoping to find a shred of regret, but instead my glowing forehead badge blares a humiliating three profile views for everyone on the morning commute to see. You still checking their Spotify playlist at midnight? My core temperature drops instantly, my blue skin flushing purple with pure embarrassment and white-hot fury as the train screeches to a halt, vowing to make him pay for every smug laugh. You'll see that in Level 2.
